issues.description: Constructor in the template class defines the query register under a different attribute name (_query_register) but the rest of the class (and run() helper) expects self.query_register. This naming mismatch (and the placeholder 0 qubits) makes the template's constructor invalid/unusable and will prevent students from running or completing Exercise 1. The solution uses self.query_register and a 2-qubit register, so the template structure conflicts with the intended design.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the template's constructor consistent with the rest of the class and the solution: define self.query_register (not self._query_register) and set the default number_of_qubits_query_register to 2. For example: 
- set self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 2
- use self.query_register = QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register)
- construct the circuit with self.qc = QuantumCircuit(self.query_register)
This aligns the template with the problem description and the solution implementation and removes the attribute-name bug that blocks students.
